comment: Focus pseudo-classes (spec 3.5.4). 'keyboard': Tab focuses #input (the first tabbable element): :focus and :focus-visible on #input only (yellow fill, #c02060 border), :focus-within on #fieldwrap's ancestors #form and #outer (green, lavender), never :focus on an ancestor (no #e02020) and nothing on the sibling #other. 'mouse': a click focuses #box: :focus (blue) but not :focus-visible, and the form loses :focus-within.
